topic: The player who represented two rival nations in the same tournament
hook: He played for two rival countries in the same tournament.
script: He played for two rival countries in the same tournament. Dirk Nannes played for the Netherlands and Australia at different points in his career. He faced former teammates on the pitch. Same skills. Different jersey. Different anthem. Cricket's passport rules made it possible. And deeply awkward. Follow for cricket facts that sound completely made up.
